title: Wauwepex (Cold Spring Harbor)
summary: Wauwepex is the reported Native name for the original settlement on the west side of Cold Spring Harbor. The name is interpreted as a good little water-place.
history_content: The locality took its remembered name from a good spring or water-place, paralleling the English name Cold Spring.
translation_content:
Recorded forms include Wauwepex, Wawepex, Wauwepox, and Wa Wa Pex. The name is interpreted as at the good little water-place or pond.

Why Place Names Matter

“The stories associated with some places and their names are important to identity.”

— Government of the Northwest Territories, Northern Studies 10: Making the Connection for the Teacher (n.d.), Place-name discussion, PDF page 28
preservation_content: Wauwepex connects the Cold Spring Harbor landscape with Native settlement memory, springs, and the Matinecock North Shore context.
whereintheworld_content: Blue/general approximate marker on the west side of Cold Spring Harbor near the modern laboratory and harbor landscape. This is not an exact settlement boundary.
